questions.text:
Now, think about this situation. A doctor tells a couple that their genetic makeup means that they've got one in four chances of having a child with an inherited illness. 
A. Does this mean that if their first child has the illness, the next three will not have the illness?

questions.text:
Now, think about this situation. A doctor tells a couple that their genetic makeup means that they've got one in four chances of having a child with an inherited illness. 
B. Does this mean that each of the couple's children will have the same risk of suffering from the illness?
